verdict.rationale: Highnote documents API issuance of virtual cards (including per-agent/workflow cards) and a test environment that replicates live, but the flow takes several steps: an account holder with an approved application, then a financial account, then the card. Sensitive card data is exposed mainly through the iframe-based Card Viewer SDK, and server-side access requires full PCI compliance. The 'before you talk to anyone' line implies going live involves a sales or onboarding conversation. Missing for 10: single-call card creation, documented immediate programmatic PAN/CVV/expiry retrieval via API, self-serve sandbox-to-live promotion without a sales cycle, independent corroboration.
